# SOT — Stash Or Trash

> The Brand Barometer for live, community-powered brand trust.

SOT helps people share proof about brands, cast Stash or Trash verdicts, and discover live community sentiment. Public areas include the brand directory, community feed, awards, privacy policy, and terms.

## Public pages
- [Home](https://stash-or-trash-hub.vercel.app/): Product overview and live brand trust entry point.
- [Brand directory](https://stash-or-trash-hub.vercel.app/brands): Browse brands and their community sentiment.
- [Community feed](https://stash-or-trash-hub.vercel.app/feed): Discover public brand verdicts and evidence.
- [Awards](https://stash-or-trash-hub.vercel.app/awards): Explore recognized brands and community signals.
- [Privacy](https://stash-or-trash-hub.vercel.app/privacy)
- [Terms](https://stash-or-trash-hub.vercel.app/terms)

SOT is a community platform. Brand scores and verdicts represent user-generated sentiment and should not be treated as professional, legal, financial, or purchasing advice.
